company.name: Hoplite Dataroom
company.shortDescription: Hoplite Dataroom provides a secure online dataroom platform for storing, organizing, and sharing confidential documents.
company.description: Hoplite Dataroom provides a secure online dataroom platform for organizations that need to store, organize, and share sensitive documents. The platform supports creating and managing multiple datarooms, defining folder structures, and controlling guest access rights for viewing and downloading files. It includes administrative tools for tracking document consultation, sending alerts when new documents are available, and managing user groups. The service offers different pricing plans with defined storage limits, numbers of active datarooms, and administrator accounts, as well as custom offers. Hoplite Dataroom focuses on document exchange workflows for entities such as local authorities, small and medium-sized enterprises, social and solidarity economy organizations, regulated liberal professions, and business clubs.
